fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-06-14 states that the cousin of the complainant, Sangeetha Bai, aged 57, left for a local errand and did not return; the last known location was near Nallur Colony College Road, on 2026-06-14 around 11:10 hrs. Mathan Chandran (9000000343), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Praveen Balan was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Last known location noted near a public transport point.
fields.Keywords: missing person, adult, photograph, associate, morning, witness, college road
